title: Australia’s first grid-connected sodium-sulfur battery goes online
summary: Australia’s first grid-connected sodium-sulfur battery system has commenced operations in Queensland, helping power a critical minerals processing facility and providing a real-world demonstration of the long-duration energy storage technology. The post Australia’s first grid-connected sodium-sulfur battery goes online appeared first on pv magazine Global .
